title: analytics: in a batch query, a lookup dimension the caller may not label collapses every group into one "(restricted)" row — the grouping changes with the batch's siblings
body:
Found by a downstream app on the published 18.4.0 packages (steedos-labs/os-project-blackcat-crm, demo walk for #57). Same family as objectstack-ai/objectstack#33107 (dimension labels), different symptom: wrong **grouping**, not an unresolved label.

## Symptom

As the sales director (`chen.gang`), `POST /api/v1/analytics/dataset/query/batch?callerPackage=com.steedos.blackcat.crm.carbon` with two queries on the same dataset — `cb_order_metrics` dims `[grade]` measure `order_tonnes`, and `cb_order_metrics` dims `[rep]` measures `order_tonnes + order_count`, `runtimeFilter` order_date this year — answers the `rep` query with **one** row `{ rep: '(restricted)', order_tonnes: 3100, order_count: 5 }`: both reps merged into one group. The same `rep` query alone, or batched with any other sibling (order month, customer, KPI), answers **two** rows (by user id, the #33107 label gap). The same batch as the team manager (`wang.qiang`) answers two rows. On screen: dashboard 「炭黑销售业绩 → 按业务员」 as the director shows `(restricted) 3,100 5`.

## Why it matters

A dashboard's totals per person depend on which other tiles share the batch and on who views it; the director sees a different (and wrong) breakdown than the manager. Grouping must be by the stored value regardless of whether the label may be shown; a restricted label may replace the display text, never merge groups.

## Producer

Not pinned by the PM seat. Lead: the batch path of `packages/services/service-analytics` (the dimension-label pass and its restricted-label substitution, `dimension-labels.ts`), where a restricted label appears to be substituted before rows are grouped or deduplicated across the batch.

Dedupe words: analytics batch restricted label · dimension label restricted merges groups · dataset query batch sibling.
